subject: design/argus-attribution-hardening
statement: Human authorship on the protected subset is **positively established** by a **positive attestation trailer** — the credential-free `Governing-Change: operator` *pattern* (a merge-base `git log` read of the attestation trailer), served by **its own single-sourced positive-human reader** distinct from the shipped `hasOperatorTrailer` (which answers a different predicate — see the AP-11 note below and `## Principles`) — with a determinable in-tree committer identity as an explicitly **non-adversarial, committer-settable best-effort disambiguation** carrying **no** forgery-resistance. A protected-path diff resolves into three states under a **stated precedence — positively-Argus wins** — and the gate acts on each *(design-brainstorm:argus-attribution-hardening-tech-design#D-3)*. This **replaces** the frozen `Human = Argus-trailer-absent` inference.
